# The auth transcripts from section 3 of docs/dev/auth-ux-spec.md, asserted
# byte for byte (\A...\z anchors the whole stream, not a line).
#
# The browser and the server are replaced by the hooks in scripthooks.go,
# which are compiled in under the nlmscripttest tag and stay inert unless
# their environment variables are set. A private HOME keeps the credentials
# this file writes out of the other script tests.

env HOME=$HOME/auth-ux

# Explicit auth, success: what it is doing, with which profile, and where the
# credentials landed. Nothing else, and nothing on stdout.
env NLM_TEST_BROWSER_AUTH=ok
exec ./nlm_test auth
! stdout .
stderr '\Anlm: authenticating via browser \(profile Default\)\.\.\.\nnlm: credentials written to ~/\.nlm/env\n\z'

# A re-login with no -authuser stays on the account the last login used, and
# says which one, so a multi-account user can see the identity the browser is
# about to open. The index is inherited from the stored session, not retyped.
env NLM_AUTHUSER=3
exec ./nlm_test auth
stderr '\Anlm: authenticating via browser \(profile Default, account 3\)\.\.\.\nnlm: credentials written to ~/\.nlm/env\n\z'

# The default account is the absence of an index: -authuser 0 clears an
# inherited one instead of naming account 0.
exec ./nlm_test auth --authuser 0
stderr '\Anlm: authenticating via browser \(profile Default\)\.\.\.\nnlm: credentials written to ~/\.nlm/env\n\z'
env NLM_AUTHUSER=

# Silent refresh inside a command, success: exactly one stderr line, printed
# before the browser runs, and the command result alone on stdout.
# The credentials the login above wrote are now on disk; naming them here
# keeps this case independent of how the stored file is read.
env NLM_AUTH_TOKEN=test-token
env NLM_COOKIES=test-cookies
env NLM_TEST_INTERACTIVE=1
env NLM_TEST_COMMAND_RESULTS=401,ok:9a7e49c1-2e6f-4caa-a0b3-b6c365820062
exec ./nlm_test notebook create retro-aim
stdout '\A9a7e49c1-2e6f-4caa-a0b3-b6c365820062\n\z'
stderr '\Anlm: session expired, re-authenticating via browser \(profile Default\)\.\.\.\n\z'

# Browser login failed: one line naming the cause in user terms, one naming
# the next thing to try, and the auth-failed class.
env 'NLM_TEST_PROFILES=Default,Profile 3'
env 'NLM_TEST_BROWSER_AUTH=fail:insufficient cookies data'
! exec ./nlm_test auth
stderr '\Anlm: authenticating via browser \(profile Default\)\.\.\.\nnlm: login failed: profile Default has no notebook\.google\.com cookies\nnlm: try: nlm auth --profile "Profile 3", or nlm auth --cdp-url ws://localhost:9222\nnlm: exit-class=auth-failed \(exit 9\)\n\z'

# Non-interactive, expired: no browser, one line naming both ways forward,
# and the auth class (exit 3).
env NLM_TEST_INTERACTIVE=0
env NLM_TEST_BROWSER_AUTH=ok
env NLM_TEST_COMMAND_RESULTS=401
! exec ./nlm_test notebook list
! stdout .
stderr '\Anlm: session expired; run `nlm auth` in a terminal \(or set NLM_AUTH_TOKEN and NLM_COOKIES\)\nnlm: exit-class=auth \(exit 3\)\n\z'

# R2: every line nlm writes to stderr carries the nlm: prefix. The pattern
# matches only a stream made entirely of such lines.
stderr '\A(nlm: [^\n]*\n)*\z'
